author: yulinkservices
title: Hiring remote graphic artist
content: 📣 We’re Looking for a Graphic Artist (Remote, Commission-Based) 📣 What You’ll Do: Transform customer-provided JPEG logos or artwork into high-quality, production-ready designs quickly and efficiently, without relying on AutoTrace or equivalent programs. Bring creativity and precision to artwork... What We Are Looking For: Minimum of 2 years of vector design experience in Adobe Illustrator... Open to Filipino citizens only. This is a remote, commission-based role paid per artwork. Earnings can reach up to ₱38,000 per month or more... 📩 Send your resume and portfolio to: yulinkhr@gmail.com Subject line: Graphic Artist – [Your Full Name] Contact: yulinkhr@gmail.com
